sql: SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero AS s JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE LOWER(a.attribute_name) = 'strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute AS ha2 JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id WHERE LOWER(a2.attribute_name) = 'strength');
